claims.claim: At least 16 people are feared to have drowned in Bihar on Sunday, October 11, 2026, while collecting river water for Kalash Sthapana on the first day of Dussehra.
claims.episode_span: At least 16 people are feared to have drowned in Bihar on Sunday, October 11
claims.source_title: 16 people drowned to death in Bihar on the first day of Dussehra festival
claims.supporting_quote: at least 16 people are feared to have drowned to death in Bihar when they had gone to fetch holy water from rivers for Kalash Sthapana

claims.claim: A senior Patna police official said recent flooding raised river levels, that 16 deaths occurred on Sunday, and that the toll may rise.
claims.episode_span: recent flooding had raised river levels and that people had gone into deep water
claims.source_title: 16 people drowned to death in Bihar on the first day of Dussehra festival
claims.supporting_quote: He said that as many as 16 deaths happened across the state on Sunday, but “the death toll may go up”.

claims.claim: Most drowning reports came from Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga and Sitamarhi, with one death each recorded in Samastipur, Sheohar, Bhojpur, Saran, Begusarai, Nawada and Rohtas.
claims.episode_span: one death each in Samastipur, Sheohar, Bhojpur, Saran, Begusarai, Nawada and Rohtas
claims.source_title: 16 people drowned to death in Bihar on the first day of Dussehra festival
claims.supporting_quote: one death has been recorded each in districts like Samastipur, Sheohar, Bhojpur, Saran, Begusarai, Nawada and Rohtas.

claims.claim: Sarvesh Kumar and Neeraj Kumar, both under 15, died by electrocution in Bagaha, West Champaran, on the way to fetch holy water.
claims.episode_span: Sarvesh Kumar and Neeraj Kumar, both under 15, died by electrocution
claims.source_title: 16 people drowned to death in Bihar on the first day of Dussehra festival
claims.supporting_quote: Two children — Sarvesh Kumar and Neeraj Kumar, both below the age of 15 — died in the Bagaha area under Ramnagar police station of West Champaran district in an incident of electrocution

claims.claim: The Joint Tribes Council Manipur issued a 48-hour ultimatum for the return of the severed head of 52-year-old Ajinbou R.
claims.episode_span: a non-negotiable 48-hour ultimatum for the return of the severed head of Ajinbou R., 52
claims.source_title: Naga group seeks return of man's severed head after fresh Manipur violence, issues 48-hr ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: The council issued a "non-negotiable 48-hour ultimatum" to locate and return the severed head

claims.claim: Ajinbou R. was allegedly killed on Saturday in Makui Ashang village, Kangpokpi, and his headless body reached JNIMS in Imphal on Sunday night.
claims.episode_span: His headless body was brought to Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal on Sunday night
claims.source_title: Naga group seeks return of man's severed head after fresh Manipur violence, issues 48-hr ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: The headless body of 52-year-old Ajinbou R., allegedly killed in a suspected militant attack on Makui Ashang village in Kangpokpi district on Saturday (October 10, 2026), was brought to Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal for post-mortem on Sunday (October 11, 2026) night.

claims.claim: The council said post-mortem would wait until the head was returned and held the state and central governments responsible.
claims.episode_span: it holds the state and central governments directly responsible
claims.source_title: Naga group seeks return of man's severed head after fresh Manipur violence, issues 48-hr ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: Holding State and Central governments directly responsible for the renewed violence, it said, "This heinous crime is an affront to humanity."

claims.claim: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh condemned the killings and asked authorities to restore peace.
claims.episode_span: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh condemned the killings
claims.source_title: Naga group seeks return of man's severed head after fresh Manipur violence, issues 48-hr ultimatum
claims.supporting_quote: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh has condemned the killings and asked the authorities concerned to take immediate and "effective steps to control the situation, restore peace and order and ensure the safety and security of all citizens".

claims.claim: Emma Hughes told a New South Wales inquiry that in 1998 Redeemer Baptist School students often had to share beds with teachers on camps.
claims.episode_span: in 1998 a student often had to share a bed with a teacher
claims.source_title: Sydney private school made students share bed with teachers, inquiry hears
claims.supporting_quote: Hughes, who was not a member of the church community, said that in 1998 it was often necessary for a student to share a bed with a teacher, as there was not enough space in the cabin.

claims.claim: Edward Garth said he was 12 in June 2015 when he saw principal Jonathan Cannon walk naked through a homestay living space shared with students.
claims.episode_span: he saw Cannon walk naked from a bathroom through a living room
claims.source_title: Sydney private school made students share bed with teachers, inquiry hears
claims.supporting_quote: I saw Jonathan Cannon, my principal, walk out of the bathroom into the living room naked before heading to his room.

claims.claim: A Redeemer spokesperson said there was no record the suggested incident with Cannon occurred.
claims.episode_span: there was no record the suggested incident with Cannon occurred
claims.source_title: Sydney private school made students share bed with teachers, inquiry hears
claims.supporting_quote: A Redeemer spokesperson said there was no record the suggested incident with Cannon occurred.

claims.claim: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck Tonga on Monday with its epicenter 123 kilometers west of Neiafu at a depth of 164.8 kilometers, according to the USGS as reported by QNA.
claims.episode_span: epicenter 123 kilometers west of Neiafu at a depth of 164.8 kilometers
claims.source_title: Magnitude 5.5 Earthquake Strikes Tonga in Pacific Ocean
claims.supporting_quote: The US Geological Survey (USGS) reported that the epicenter of the earthquake was located 123 kilometers west of Neiafu, and at a depth of 164.8 kilometers.

claims.claim: Kahf apologised after a meme posted following Indonesia's FIFA ASEAN Cup win drew criticism for appearing to belittle Malaysia.
claims.episode_span: Kahf apologised after posting a meme following Indonesia's win in the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup
claims.source_title: Football meme sparks boycott calls in Malaysia; Indonesian grooming brand apologises
claims.supporting_quote: Men’s grooming brand Kahf posted the meme after Indonesia won the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup. Netizens criticised it for appearing to belittle Malaysia and other countries.

claims.claim: Tobias Moran has sued NSW Police for malicious prosecution over his arrest related to Simone Strobel's 2005 death in Lismore.
claims.episode_span: filed civil proceedings against NSW Police for malicious prosecution
claims.source_title: Boyfriend of murdered backpacker sues police over arrest
claims.supporting_quote: Tobias Moran files civil proceedings against NSW Police for malicious prosecution in relation to the death of his girlfriend Simone Strobel in Lismore in 2005.

claims.claim: A police pursuit in Perth's southern suburbs ended in a serious crash, with one person taken to hospital and another in custody.
claims.episode_span: one person taken to hospital and another in custody
claims.source_title: Breaking: Police pursuit ends in serious crash in Perth's south
claims.supporting_quote: A person is rushed to hospital and another is in custody after a police pursuit through Perth's southern suburbs ends in a serious crash.

claims.claim: A Melbourne Islamic centre chief rejected UAE prosecutors' claims linking his organisation to an Omani Flydubai co-pilot accused of attacking the captain.
claims.episode_span: rejected what he called false accusations after prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates linked his organisation
claims.source_title: Australian man rejects UAE links to Flydubai cockpit attack: ‘false accusations’
claims.supporting_quote: A Melbourne man whose Islamic community centre has been linked by prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates to the co-pilot who allegedly attacked the captain of a Flydubai jet has hit out at “false accusations”.

claims.claim: Emirati prosecutors' findings published by state media said the co-pilot drew inspiration from the September 11, 2001 attacks and aimed to cause the greatest possible loss of life.
claims.episode_span: drew inspiration from al-Qaeda's September 11, 2001 attacks
claims.source_title: Australian man rejects UAE links to Flydubai cockpit attack: ‘false accusations’
claims.supporting_quote: The Omani co-pilot, now in custody in the UAE, had drawn inspiration from al-Qaeda’s September 11, 2001 suicide attacks, and carried out his attempt “with the aim of causing the greatest possible loss of life”, according to the Emirati prosecutor’s findings published by state media last week.

claims.claim: INS Mangrol, an anti-submarine warfare shallow-water craft built with over 80 percent indigenous content, has been inducted into the Indian Navy.
claims.episode_span: The Indian Navy has inducted INS Mangrol
claims.source_title: INS Mangrol, anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft, inducted into Navy
claims.supporting_quote: Built with over 80% indigenous content, Mangrol reflects the country’s growing capabilities in warship construction and the integration of indigenous weapons and sensors
